// Scanner cases for tests/temp-root-guard.test.ts, one per line; the test lists the lines that count.
await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); // counted
await rm(file); // not counted: no recursion
rmSync(root, { // counted across lines
  force: true, recursive: true,
});
await fs.rm(join(a, ")"), { recursive: true }); // counted despite a bracket in a string
await rmdir(empty); // not counted
const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "x-")); // counted
const sync = mkdtempSync(prefix); // counted
await Bun.$`rm -rf ${dir}`; // counted
Bun.spawn(["rm", "-r", dir]); // counted
mock.module("node:fs/promises", () => block(promises, ["rm", "rename"])); // not counted
import { mkdtemp, rm } from "node:fs/promises"; // not counted
import { rm as remove, rmSync as removeSync, mkdtemp as makeTemp, mkdtempSync as makeTempSync } from "node:fs";
await remove(dir, { recursive: true }); // counted through the alias
removeSync(dir, { force: true }); // not counted: no recursion
await makeTemp(prefix); // counted through the alias
makeTempSync(prefix); // counted through the alias
spawnSync("rm", ["-f", "-r", dir]); // counted
execFile("rm", ["--recursive", dir]); // counted
Bun.spawnSync(["rm", "-R", dir]); // counted
spawn("rm", ["-f", dir]); // not counted: no recursion
await Bun.$`rm -f -r ${dir}`; // counted
execSync(`rm --force --recursive ${dir}`); // counted
execSync(`find ${dir} -name '*.tmp' -delete`); // counted
Bun.spawn(["find", dir, "-type", "f", "-delete"]); // counted
Bun.spawn(["find", dir, "-type", "f"]); // not counted
rm(dir, options); // counted: options in a variable aren't statically known
fs["rm"](dir, { recursive: true }); // counted through string element access
const tool = "rm"; // not counted: no flag in this statement
spawnSync("grep", ["-r", pattern, dir]); // not counted: grep, and the "rm" above is another statement
// await rm(dir, { recursive: true }); a commented-out call doesn't count
// import { rm as root } from "node:fs";
const mocked = (rm as unknown as Mock);
await root(dir, { recursive: true }); // not counted: that alias is only in a comment
unknown(dir, { recursive: true }); // not counted: a cast is not an import alias
run("rm", options); search(["-r"]); // not counted: the flag is in another call
const quote = /["'`]/; Bun.spawnSync(["rm", "-rf", dir]); // counted after a regex with quotes
const url = "https://example.test/a//b"; Bun.spawnSync(["rm", "-rf", dir]); // counted after a URL
run({ cmd: "rm", args: ["-rf", dir] }); // counted in an object literal
const text = `${Bun.spawnSync(["rm", "-rf", dir])}`; // counted inside a template substitution
rm(dir, { recursive: false }); // not counted: recursion is off
rm(dir, { ...options }); // counted: a spread isn't statically known
spawn("sh", ["-c", "rm -rf build"]); // counted in sh -c text
Bun.spawn(["bash", "-c", "find . -name '*.tmp' -delete"]); // counted once in bash -c text
Bun.spawn([process.execPath, "-e", `import { rm } from "node:fs/promises"; await rm(dir, { recursive: true });`]); // counted inside an embedded script
const erase = fs.rm; await erase(dir, { recursive: true }); // escapes: a removal function held in a variable
runCommand("rm", ["-rf", d]); // counted in any call with "rm" and a recursive flag
import { spawnSync as launch } from "node:child_process"; launch("rm", ["-R", d]); // counted through an aliased spawnSync
await promisify(exec)("rm -rf build"); // counted through promisify
const cleanup = "rm -rf build"; spawn("sh", ["-c", cleanup]); // counted where the shell text is written
const command = "rm -rf " + d; // counted in a string that builds a command
sh(`rm -rf ${d}`); // counted in a shell helper's template
await writeFile(join(d, "cleanup.sh"), "#!/bin/sh\nrm -rf build\n"); // counted in a script written to a file
rm(dir, { "recursive": true }); // counted with a string-keyed option
rm(dir, { "recursive": false, force: true }); // not counted: recursion is off
Bun.spawn([process.execPath, "-e", 'import { execSync } from "node:child_process"; execSync("rm -rf x");']); // counted once for an embedded script's shell text
git(["rm", "-r", "--cached", path]); // counted: over-counting git rm -r is acceptable
